styles.css: .aurora-announce{font-size:.85rem;letter-spacing:.01em}.aurora-announce p{margin:0}.aurora-logo img{display:block;width:40px;height:40px}.aurora-hero{position:relative;overflow:hidden;border-radius:24px}.aurora-hero::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:-40% -10% auto auto;width:70%;height:140%;background:radial-gradient(closest-side,rgba(20,184,166,.45),transparent),radial-gradient(closest-side at 30% 60%,rgba(139,92,246,.40),transparent);filter:blur(40px);pointer-events:none}.aurora-hero>*{position:relative}.aurora-eyebrow{display:inline-block;padding:.3rem .8rem;border-radius:999px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.12);font-size:.8rem;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase}.aurora-feature{border:1px solid var(--wp--preset--color--accent-6);border-radius:16px;height:100%}.aurora-feature .aurora-icon{font-size:1.6rem;line-height:1}.aurora-products .wc-block-product{border:1px solid var(--wp--preset--color--accent-6);border-radius:16px;padding:1rem;transition:box-shadow .2s ease,transform .2s ease}.aurora-products .wc-block-product:hover{box-shadow:0 12px 30px rgba(11,16,38,.10);transform:translateY(-2px)}.aurora-products .wc-block-components-product-image img{border-radius:12px}.wc-block-product .wp-block-post-title a,.wc-block-product .wp-block-post-title{color:var(--wp--preset--color--contrast);text-decoration:none}.wc-block-product .wp-block-post-title a:hover{color:var(--wp--preset--color--accent-3)}.wp-block-woocommerce-customer-account a,.wc-block-customer-account__account-icon{color:var(--wp--preset--color--contrast)!important}.aurora-footer a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}.aurora-footer a:hover{text-decoration:underline}@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.aurora-products .wc-block-product{transition:none}.aurora-products .wc-block-product:hover{transform:none}}
